title: SvgPolygon
responsibility: Renders the native polygon element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgPolygon.attributes
inputs.description: Native polygon attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgPolygon.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native polygon element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgPolygon
outputs.description: The actual native polygon element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
